notes.title: Beta version of your 'PROFILE' is now available
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37457279/9b9642b61c0139cba9644fc74c665e83a748643c.png[/img]

Hello Players,
Login with your steam profile on [b]DESKTOP[/b] and get to see your overall batting profile, matches history, leaderboards, tournaments at - https://profile.ib.cricket/
[b]Currently, only desktop version of this website is available.[/b]

As informed earlier, you can see the results of every round in all the tournaments that you've participated in. Also, you get to see the wagon wheel of every single match you've played so far, milestones achieved in the challenges & more. Hope you're excited!

As this is a Beta version, if you encounter any issues, please do inform us on "beta-feedback" channel of discord. 

Take a screenshot of the wagon wheel of your best match & share it with the community.
Discord - https://discord.gg/JCbDw82
Reddit - https://www.reddit.com/r/iBCricket/

notes.title: One of the most exciting update coming up this February
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37457279/0d1c18c9def8f3e294d19d36c5ca600d458602bf.jpg[/img]

Hello Players,
More fun coming your way! 
This February we're launching a website from where you get to see your overall batting statistics, matches history, leaderboards, tournaments & more. Also, you can get to see the ongoing status of the tournament even if you are knocked out of it. 

Hope you are excited. Stay tuned for more updates!
Discord - https://discord.gg/JCbDw82
Reddit - https://www.reddit.com/r/iBCricket/

notes.title: Public Beta for Online PvP will release on February 5th
notes.notes:
Hello Players,
Hope you're enjoying the local PvP. On February 5th we're releasing the public beta for Online PvP. We're also incorporating your requests such as an option to adjust the size of bat shield within PvP and also to play with 10 wickets in 20 overs.

Stay Tuned!

notes.title: Early Access Release Date
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37457279/88fb9ada2d7e26282668ec23c14e180cc702c0c5.jpg[/img]

Greetings everyone! We’re excited to announce that iB Cricket Early Access is releasing on 25th October.

A huge shout out to all of our beta testers whose feedback helped us improve the game.
In Early Access, you can

[list]
[*] Play unlimited overs
[*] Take up Exciting Challenges
[*] Compete in Tournaments
[*] Experience playing in world-class stadiums
[*] Hone your skills with the coaching module.
[*] A lot more fun coming on your way !!! 
[/list]

Join us on Discord - https://discord.gg/JCbDw82

notes.title: iB Cricket Closed Beta Testing and Early Access Release Update
notes.notes:
Hi Folks,

We know you’re all eagerly waiting for the release of the game. Even we are excited to bring iB Cricket to you all. Currently, the game is in the closed beta testing phase and we are receiving fantastic responses from the beta-testers. We are incorporating the feedback received to make sure we provide you with an incredible VR experience. 

We are preparing to release the Demo version as well as the Early Access version of iB Cricket by mid-June. Can't wait to see you guys enjoy the vSport!

Don't forget to add iB Cricket to your wishlist, so you won't miss any announcements and updates. 😊
